Bashecho "===== RUNTIME OPERATIONS ENTRYPOINTS ====="

grep -Rni \
  "function RuntimeOperationsWorkspace\|export function RuntimeOperationsWorkspace\|export default RuntimeOperationsWorkspace" \
  apps/lumina-builder/src \
  --include='*.tsx' \
  --exclude-dir=node_modules

echo
echo "===== RUNTIME OPERATIONS FILES ====="

find apps/lumina-builder/src \
  -type f \
  \( -iname '*RuntimeOperations*.tsx' -o -path '*runtime-operations*' \) \
  -print \
  -exec wc -l {} \; \
  | sort

echo
echo "===== KNOWLEDGE EXECUTIVE PRIMITIVE USAGE ====="

grep -RniE \
  'ExecutiveWorkspaceShell|ExecutiveGlassPanel|ExecutivePanelHeader|ExecutivePanelBody|ExecutiveSection|ExecutiveExecutionFrame|ExecutiveActivityRail|ExecutiveInspectorDock|ExecutiveSpatialCanvas|LuminaCompositionSurface' \
  apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces \
  apps/lumina-builder/src/components/lumina \
  --include='*.tsx' \
  --include='*.ts' \
  --exclude-dir=node_modules

echo
echo "===== CURRENT STATUS ====="

git status --short --branch
The first polish milestone should touch only the Runtime Operations outer shell and major surface composition. No Runtime logic changes, no shared primitive redesign, no commit or push until build and visual approval.
